snippet.title: VR Giants – Now Available on Meta Quest | Official Launch
snippet.description:
Step into the world of VR Giants — the asymmetrical co-op VR adventure where teamwork is everything! Play as Goliath, the towering VR giant, or David, the tiny but agile companion, and conquer puzzles, challenges, and biomes together.

Whether you’re playing on Meta Quest, Steam, or using the free Friend’s Pass, the adventure starts now.

Join our community, find co-op partners, and get the latest updates:

🌐 Join the VR Giants Community
Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/gQ3eyfY

🟦 Get VR Giants on Meta Quest
https://www.meta.com/experiences/vr-giants/8767606526672881/

🟩 Get VR Giants on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124160/VR_Giants/

🌍 Official Website
https://vrgiants.com/
